title: Export & import
intro: Move a whole site between NodePress installs: choice lists, components, content types, every entry, in every language and status, forms, webhooks and redirects, in one JSON file.
mediaNote: Media files aren't included. Entries keep their image links, which keep working while the files stay on R2, S3, ImageKit or the old server.
exportText: Download the whole site as one JSON file. It includes drafts, form settings such as email recipients, and webhook secrets, so keep it private.
importText: Choose a site export. Content types are matched by name, entries by slug and language, forms by slug, webhooks by name and URL and redirects by source path, and relations between entries keep working.
invalidFile: This isn't a NodePress site export
overwriteHint: Off: content types, entries, forms, webhooks and redirects that already exist here are kept as they are.
cliHint: For large sites, use the CLI: npx nodepress site:export and npx nodepress site:import.
entriesLine: Entries: {toCreate} new, {toUpdate} to update, {toRestore} restored from the trash, {toSkip} kept as they are
formsLine: Forms: {toCreate} new, {toUpdate} to update, {toSkip} kept as they are
webhooksLine: Webhooks: {toCreate} new, {toUpdate} to update, {toSkip} kept as they are
redirectsLine: Redirects: {toCreate} new, {toUpdate} to update, {toSkip} kept as they are
webhooksActive: After the import, this site sends events to these addresses. If this is a test copy, change or switch them off right after importing:
relinked: {count, plural, one {# entry has} other {# entries have}} a different id on this site; relations to them are updated.
problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}: nothing is imported until the file is fixed
